question: Who was responsible for killing the last Mauryan King?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pushyamitra Sunga.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Sunga Dynasty was established by the Pushyamitra Sunga by overthrowing the Maurya Dynasty in 185 BCE.
 
• Pushyamitra Sunga ruled for about 36 years from 185 BCE to 149 BCE.
 
• There were 10 rulers in the Sunga dynasty who in total rulers for 112 years.
 
• Patiliputra is the capital city of the Sunga Dynasty.
